lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: That is all for now.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Hm. New face. You are the one who held the plains road.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: I am Bram. I make steel. You look like you need some.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Heard the Goblin King is dead. Good. Fewer dents to hammer out of caravan wheels.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Goblins trading in the square. Never thought I would see it. Their iron is rubbish, mind.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: They say you took the King's gold and left him his crown. The raids will be back.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: The whole realm talks about that throne. And you still buy from me. Hm.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Back again. Good. Steel does not sell itself.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Show me your goods.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Plain steel, honest prices. Look all you like.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Bram. Thirty years at this anvil.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: I shoe horses, mend ploughs, and arm fools like you. In that order.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What should I carry out there?

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: A shield, if you mean to be hit. A bigger sword, if you do not.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Strength swings my steel. Put your points there before you buy heavy.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Heard anything lately?

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Goblins on the plains road. Clear them out before you shop for anything fancy.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: The raiders crawl out of the Goblin Hollows, past the plains. Their king sits at the bottom.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: East of the plains the Whispering Woods begin. The trees walk there. Bring an axe.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Smoke over Oakhaven way. A warlord has his camp on the outskirts, they say.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Ironhold steel is on the road again. Go north if you want better than mine.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Wear it in good health. Or at all.

lines.speaker: sunfordSmith
lines.text: Mind the road.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Ooh, a customer! Or a guard. You are not a guard, are you?

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: I am Tilly. Rings, charms, lucky things. All found, never stolen.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Have you seen Grik's stall? Goblin trinkets! I am ruined. Buy something. Pity me.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: My favourite customer! I say that to everyone, but with you I mean it.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Rings! Charms! Things I found and definitely did not steal.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: I walk the roads and pick up what the roads leave behind.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Bandits drop the nicest things when they run.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What are trinkets good for?

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: You wear two at a time, one on each hand. A small edge is still an edge.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You stole all of this, didn't you?

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Shh! Not so loud. Fine. FINE.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Take this ring and we never spoke. It is a nice ring. Mostly copper.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: There is a colosseum south of here with its gates rusted shut. They would open if the goblin trouble ended.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: The Colosseum is open! Eight waves, they say. I sell luck. You will want luck.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Oakhaven's markets pay double for anything shiny. Go east, past the woods.

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Come back when you are richer!

lines.speaker: sunfordPeddler
lines.text: Mind your pockets out there! Not near me, I mean. Elsewhere.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Stand straight. You face a knight of the Iron Order.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Ser Aldric. I teach the shield to those who would stand in front of others.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Oakhaven stands because you stood. That is the whole of what I teach.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: You opened Oakhaven's gate. I have buried men for less. State your business.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: A dragonslayer in my yard. They will sing of it in the great hall.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: The Order speaks well of you. For its friends, my lessons cost less.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: The Order names you an enemy. I will teach you still. Honour is not theirs to revoke.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Shield up. What do you need?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Teach me.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Then pay attention. I show a thing once.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is an Aegis Knight?

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: A wall that walks. We take the blow so that nothing else must.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Strength for the arm, Endurance for the rest. The light does what it can.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Am I ready for more?

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: You have the arm for most of what I know. Mind your Endurance and take the rest.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: You are ready for the next lesson. Do not let it go to your head.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Not yet. Your arm is weak and you tire fast. More Strength, more Endurance.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about the Iron Order.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: We keep the roads and the law. Some say too much of both.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Stand with the Order, and its armourers and its teachers remember you.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Practise it until it bores you. Then practise more.

lines.speaker: trainerAegis
lines.text: Go with the light.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Oh! A student? Stand back a little. A little more.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Ember Wren, pyromancer. The eyebrows grow back, mostly.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: You gave the core to the Circle! Do you know how many things we can set on fire now?

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: The Circle of Aether likes you! That means a discount. And fewer forms to sign.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: The Circle wants you turned to ash. Awkward! I will still teach you. Fire is not picky.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: You are back! And nothing is burning. We can fix that.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Yes! Watch closely. Not that closely.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does a Pyromancer do?

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Fire answers every question. Burn them first, then blow up the ones that are burning.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: It all runs on Intelligence. And a steady supply of robes.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: You could melt a golem! Take everything I have. Mind your Skill for the tricky ones.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Your mind is warm enough for the next spell. Come on!

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Hmm. Not enough Intelligence yet. The fire would use you, not the other way round.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Who are the Circle of Aether?

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Scholars. We study what the world is made of. Some of it explodes.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Go and set something on fire! Something that deserves it.

lines.speaker: trainerPyro
lines.text: Stay warm!

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: So you are the one from the road. Come closer, my eyes are not what they were.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: I am Mara. I have kept this town's ledger and its peace for forty years.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: The Hollows are quiet. You did a hard thing, and Sunford sleeps because of it.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Goblins selling trinkets in my square. You have a silver tongue, child. I hope it holds.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: You took his gold and left him his crown. I am too old to pretend I am not disappointed.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Word came from Oakhaven. The gate held. I am glad one of ours was there.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Oakhaven is burned, and they say you held the torch. Do not tell me. I would rather not know.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: They say you decided who sits in the Dread Fortress. From Sunford's road to that. Imagine.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Sit a moment. The road will wait.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You wanted to see me?

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: You held the road when our militia could not. The town took up a collection.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: It is not much. It is every coin we could spare.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is troubling Sunford?

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: The raids come from the Goblin Hollows. The goblins have crowned a king.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: And you want him dead.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: I want the raids to end. How is for you to decide, at the bottom of those caves.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: The Hollows lie just beyond the plains. Go carefully.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About the Goblin King…

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: A king is dead and my caravans run on time. I will not ask how it felt.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: A pact! My mother would have fainted. Still, trade is better than funerals.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Gold spends fast. Grudges do not. Remember that when the raids return.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about Sunford.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Farmers, mostly. A smith, a healer, and two teachers who put up with us.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Rest here, spend your points, and go back out stronger. That is what a home is for.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Where should I go next?

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: The plains road, before anything else. We cannot eat if the caravans cannot pass.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: The Goblin Hollows first. Nothing else is safe while the raids go on.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: East, through the Whispering Woods. The road to Oakhaven runs under those trees.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Oakhaven is under siege. If its outskirts fall, the town falls.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: North, child. The Ashen Crags, and Ironhold beyond. The trouble grows the further you go.

lines.speaker: elderMara
lines.text: Come back alive. That is all I ask of anyone.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Hold still. No, you are fine. Force of habit.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Sister Lune. I mend what the road breaks.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Still in one piece? I am almost disappointed.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Patch me up.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Sit. Rest. You leave here whole, with every flask filled.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: I need something for my mana.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Blue flask, bitter taste. Sip it when your spells run dry.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: How do the potions work?

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: You carry a few flasks into every zone. Drink before you need one, not after.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: If you want to carry more, I can sell you a longer belt.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: The goblins poison their sling stones. If you turn green, come straight back.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Spider bites from the Woods. Three this week. Do try not to get bitten.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Soldiers come down from the north with burns. The Ashen Crags, they say. Fire that walks.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Keep the belt full and your head down.

lines.speaker: sunfordHealer
lines.text: Try not to bleed on anything important.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Tall one! Tall one made the pact. King say be nice to tall one.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Grik is nice. Grik has shinies. Tall one has gold. Is good match.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Tall one comes back! Grik knew. Shinies call to tall one.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: King say trade, so Grik trade. Shiny for shiny. Good shiny.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: How is your king?

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: King is fat and happy. No more raiding. Raiding is hard work.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: King says tall one has good tongue. Is highest goblin praise. Almost.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: How do you like Sunford?

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Humans wash too much. But pies! Grik did not know about pies.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Grik's cousins dig north, in black rock. They say fire walks there. Grik stays here.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Deep places are waking up, tall one. Goblins feel it in the feet.

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Good trade! Tall one comes again, yes?

lines.speaker: goblinTrader
lines.text: Bye, tall one! Do not die. Dead ones buy nothing.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Another sword. Good. I stopped asking where they come from.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Captain Hale. I command what is left of Oakhaven's watch.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: The gate held. Three hundred years, and now one more. I owe you my town.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: You settled the throne of the Dread Fortress. My walls feel smaller than they did.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: The walls still stand. For today.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Oakhaven remembers, friend. So do I.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is the situation?

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: A warlord's army has us surrounded. Krag. He does not fight for free.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Who pays him?

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: The Ashen Syndicate. They want a town of their own, and ours has walls.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Break him at the Oakhaven Outskirts. That is where it will be decided.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About the siege…

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: They offered you a third of the town. I know. They offered me a quarter.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: The Syndicate hunts you now, on every road. Watch your back out there.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about Oakhaven.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: A trade town. Everything that moves between the plains and the mountains pays a toll here.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: That is why everyone wants it. That is why I will not give it up.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Do you serve the Iron Order?

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: I serve Oakhaven. The Order and I agree, most days. It is not the same thing.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: North of the woods the ground is black and burning. The Ashen Crags. Cultists feed the fires.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Ironhold has stopped sending steel. Something is wrong in its mines.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: The far north has gone quiet. In my experience, quiet is worse.

lines.speaker: captainHale
lines.text: Keep your sword loose.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: If you want a helmet, you are late. They are all on the wall.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Odo. Armourer. Tired.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Still here. Still short of stock.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Half my stock went up on the walls. Take what is left.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Twenty years I have armoured this town. I never thought to see all of it worn at once.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What armour should I wear?

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Plate if you stand still. Leather if you do not. Robes if you enjoy dying.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: If the siege breaks, I open the back room. The good plate. Break it for me, will you?

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: It will hold. Probably.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Keep your head down.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: You! Get in here. The back room is open, and it is open for YOU.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Master Odo, they call me now. Business is good when a town is alive.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: From my gate to the Dread Fortress. I tell everyone I fitted your armour.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: The hero of the gate. What will it be today?

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: You saved this town. The good plate comes out of the back room for you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: How is the town?

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Rich. Loud. Full of merchants who complain about the toll.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: It is wonderful. I have not slept in a week.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: My steel comes from Ironhold, and Ironhold has gone silent. Someone should look at its mines.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: The best ore I ever saw came out of the tundra. The men who brought it never went back.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: If it does not fit, come back. I will make it fit.

lines.speaker: oakArmorer
lines.text: Oakhaven's gate is always open to you. Just to you.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Buying or looking? Looking costs nothing. Touching costs a finger.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Senna. I sell edges. I do not ask what they are for.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: The siege broke. Shame. War is good for business. Peace is good for collecting debts.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Back for something sharper?

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Sharp, balanced, and sold to whoever pays. Today that is you.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: I sold swords to both sides of three wars. I am still here. They mostly are not.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Krag's men carry good steel. Syndicate money. Take it off them if you can.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Fast blades want Dexterity. Guns and bows want Skill. Know which you are before you pay me.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Blood wipes off. Rust does not. Oil it.

lines.speaker: oakWeapons
lines.text: Do not die owing me money.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: Do not turn around. I am joking. Turn around.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: They call me the Whisper. I teach people to arrive unnoticed.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: The town is quieter now. Fewer guards. I rather like it.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: The Syndicate counts you a friend. Friends pay less. Friends also know too much.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: The Syndicate wants you dead. I was paid to teach, not to kill. Lucky you.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: You are louder than last time. We will work on it.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: Quietly, then. Watch my feet, not my hands.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Shadowblade?

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: A knife that is already behind you. Step out of the dark, strike, and be gone.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: Dexterity above all. Skill, when you want the cut to count.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: You move well. Take what I know. Bring Skill for the smoke.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: Good. Your hands are quick enough for the next step.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: You walk like a cart. More Dexterity. Then we talk.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Who are the Ashen Syndicate?

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: People who noticed that laws are for sale. I do not judge. I invoice.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: Now go and do it where nobody sees.

lines.speaker: trainerShadow
lines.text: You never saw me.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You may approach. Not that close.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Lord Castellan, of the old blood of Oakhaven. I teach command.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: My town stands, and my family's name with it. You have a lord's gratitude. It is worth a great deal.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: A friend of the Order. I shall reduce my fee. Do not mention it to anyone.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: The Order has posted your name. I shall teach you anyway. Coin is coin, alas.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Ah. My most promising subject.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Very well. Observe how one gives an order.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Grand Sovereign?

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Why fight alone when others can do it for you? Summon guards. Command them.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: It takes Charisma. One cannot lead by mumbling.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You have presence. Take the rest of my lessons, and do stand up straight.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Your voice carries. You are ready for the next lesson.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Nobody would follow you to a bakery. More Charisma.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about your family.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: We built the walls Captain Hale stands on. He forgets. I remind him. Often.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Now go and be obeyed.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You are dismissed.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Next! Oh. You can walk. That makes a nice change.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Brother Fenn. Forty wounded on the wall, and one of me.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: No new wounded in three days! I do not know what to do with my hands.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: You again, and still walking. I approve.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Lie down. No, the clean cot. There. Every flask filled. Off you go.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: A mana draught! Tastes of pennies. Works, though.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Can I carry more potions?

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: A longer belt holds more flasks. I sell those. The flasks I fill for free.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Krag's archers aim for the legs. Keep moving out there and they miss.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Burns, frostbite, and one man who swears a statue bit him. The north is not kind.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Go on. Next time come for a chat, not a stitch.

lines.speaker: oakHealer
lines.text: Walk it off! That is medical advice.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: No names. You are the one who opened the gate, though. That one I know.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: Call me the Fence. Everything here fell off a cart.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: The Syndicate does not like you today. Your gold, it still likes.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: Ah. My best customer. Nobody followed you? Good.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: No names, no questions. The Syndicate takes its cut, you take the goods.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: Before the fire I sold candles. Legally. It was dreadful.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Any armour for sale?

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: The armourers are gone, friend. Burned out. You would know.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: A fortress appeared in the far north last year. Nobody built it. Its walls hum.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: Somebody is buying every void crystal on the market. Not us. That worries me.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: You were never here.

lines.speaker: blackMarket
lines.text: Mind the rubble.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: A visitor. Do mind the jars.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Doctor Sangrel. Oakhaven's new owners do not ask what I teach. Refreshing.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: You found me. Few look for a doctor in a place like this.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Doctor Sangrel. The towns burn my kind, so I work where there are none.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: The Syndicate vouches for you. My fee is lower for its friends. My standards are not.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: The Syndicate would pay me for your blood. I prefer you spend it on my lessons.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: You are pale. Good. It suits the work.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Roll up your sleeve. This will hurt. That is the point.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Blood Alchemist?

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: You pay for power in your own health. Then you drink it back from the enemy.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Endurance is your purse. Intelligence decides how well you spend it.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: A remarkable constitution. You may learn nearly all of it.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Your blood is strong enough for the next lesson.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: You would faint at the first cut. More Endurance, please.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is in the jars?

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Volunteers. Mostly.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Do keep notes. For science.

lines.speaker: trainerBlood
lines.text: Stay healthy. You are no use to me otherwise.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: So. The one who opened the gate. Sit. You have earned a chair.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: They call me Madam Ash. Oakhaven is mine now. In part, yours.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: The throne of the Dread Fortress. Ours. You are the best investment I ever made.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: You gave the throne away. To someone else. We will speak of that. Not today.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: You have been crossing us. Sit anyway. I like to look at a problem before I solve it.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: My favourite traitor. What can the Syndicate do for you?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You promised me a third of Oakhaven.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: A third of a ruin, darling. Here is this season's share.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: It will grow. A ruin is very profitable when you own its only market.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does the Syndicate want?

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: What everyone wants. We simply do not pretend otherwise.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: Stay our friend, and the Whisper and the Doctor charge you less. Loyalty has a price list.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Iron Order is hunting me.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: Of course it is. You burned one of its towns. Carry more potions.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: The dwarves found something in their mines. A core. I want it. Bring it to us and name a number.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: The core arrived safely. You should see what it does to a lock.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: Everything worth stealing has moved north. So have we.

lines.speaker: syndicateBoss
lines.text: Do not be a stranger. Strangers get followed.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You came through the mines. I can smell the dust on you.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Dorn. Forgemaster of Ironhold. I have a problem the size of a mountain.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The light is out and the golems are scrap. My miners sang last night. First time in a year.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Blue fire in my forges and robes in my halls. The work is good. I will get used to the robes.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You sold it. The golems still walk and my mines are still a grave. Get out of my light.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: So the throne is settled. Good. Now the realm can go back to arguing about iron.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Speak. The forge does not wait.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What happened in the mines?

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: We dug for iron and struck a heart. An aether core. It beats, down there in the dark.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: And the golems?

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: They walk to its rhythm. Three powers have written to me for it. All polite. I trust none.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You will reach it first, at the bottom of the Ironhold Mines. Then it is yours to settle.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About the core…

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You broke a wonder to save my people. The Order sent armourers in thanks. I sent ale.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The Circle's tinkers are mad, but their guns shoot straight. A fair bargain.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Gold. You did it for gold. I hope it keeps you warm.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about Ironhold.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The best steel in the realm, when the mines run.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Stonefoot teaches earth, Pim teaches machines. Both will talk your ear off.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: East of the Crags the land goes white. Frostbite Tundra. Giants, and dead that do not stay down.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: My scouts saw a fortress in the north that was not there last year. I do not like new mountains.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The Dread Fortress is where this ends. Every road north leads to its gate.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Strike true.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Hands off the display. Those are sharp at both ends.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Hilda Hammerhand. Dwarf-forged, every piece.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: You killed the dragon? With one of MINE? No? Lie to me. Say it was one of mine.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Back for real steel?

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Dwarf-forged. If it breaks, it was you.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: My mother forged for kings. I forge for whoever walks in. Times change.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: The golems in the mines are made of our own iron. It is embarrassing, frankly.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: A blade does half the work. Your Strength does the rest. Do not blame the blade.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Bring it back dull and I will know you used it.

lines.speaker: ironWeapons
lines.text: Hit them hard.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Careful! That one is loaded. So is that one. Most of them, really.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Tinker Voss. The Circle sent me to see what the core could teach us. Everything, it turns out.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Oh good, a tester. I mean, a customer.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: The Circle's study of the core changed everything. Hold this. Do not point it at me.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What did the core teach you?

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: That iron can think, a little. I try not to dwell on it.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Guns run on Skill, and they run hot. Ask Gearwright Pim about heat before you melt your hand.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Report any explosions! For the notes.

lines.speaker: ironAetherWorks
lines.text: Mind the recoil!

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Garrun. Armour. Rings in the tray.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Plate that turns a giant's club. Rings for the rest of you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You do not talk much.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Giants in the tundra. Clubs like tree trunks. Buy the heavy plate.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Demons up north. Fire and claws. Buy the heavy plate.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: ironArmor
lines.text: Aye.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Name and business. No. I know your name. You destroyed the core.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Quartermaster of the Iron Order. Its armouries are open to you.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: The Order holds the Dread Fortress by your hand. Stand easy. That is an order.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: The Order has you on a list. My orders are to sell to you regardless. I do not like them.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Requisition?

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: The Order remembers who destroyed the core. Choose what you need.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does the Order want from me?

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Nothing. That is rare. Enjoy it.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: The Order will want the throne in the Dread Fortress. It will remember who stood with it.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Sign here. I am joking. The Order does not joke. Dismissed.

lines.speaker: ironOrderArmor
lines.text: Dismissed.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: Slow down. The mountain is not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: They call me Old Stonefoot. I listen to the ground. Sometimes it answers.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: The mountain's heartbeat changed. That was you. It noticed.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: A dragon flew over the peak yesterday and did not burn us. Your doing, I hear.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: You again. The stones said you would come.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: Plant your feet. Feel that? No? We will start there.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Geomancer?

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: We raise walls, call spikes, and break the ground when it is needed.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: Strength to move the stone, Intelligence to ask it nicely.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: The stone knows you now. Learn the rest.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: You are heavy enough for the next lesson. That is a compliment.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: The stone does not hear you yet. More Strength.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Which faction do you serve?

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: None. Orders, syndicates, circles. The mountain outlasts all of them.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: Go gently. Then not gently.

lines.speaker: trainerGeo
lines.text: Walk softly.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Do not touch that! Or that. Actually, stand on the rug. The rug is safe.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Gearwright Pim! Guns, turrets, heat gauges. Mostly heat gauges.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: You gave us the core! I have not slept in nine days. Look at my hands. Do not look at my hands.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: The Circle is furious about the oracle. I just build things. Please do not tell them I taught you.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: A friend of the Circle! Cheaper lessons for you. I filled in the form myself.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: The Circle says I must not teach you. The Circle also says not to test rockets indoors.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Oh good, you still have all your fingers.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Right! Safety first. Then the loud part.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is an Aether-Tech?

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Guns, turrets and a heat gauge. Shoot, build, and vent before it locks you out.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: It all runs on Skill. A bit of Intelligence for the big machines.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: You could strip a turret blind! Take the big machines.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Steady hands! You are ready for the next gadget.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Your hands shake. Mine too, but for other reasons. More Skill.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What happens if I overheat?

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Everything locks for a few seconds. Vent early. Vent often. I have the scars.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Remember: vent the heat! VENT. THE. HEAT.

lines.speaker: trainerAether
lines.text: Do not blow up!

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Boots off. I will not have mine dust on my floor.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Mother Brynja. I have set every broken bone in this mountain twice.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: You went to the Dread Fortress and walked back. Sit. I want to look at you.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Still alive. I am told that is my doing.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Sit. Drink this. Do not make that face. Your flasks are filled.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Here. It tastes foul. Drink it when your magic runs out, not before.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Can I carry more potions?

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Buy a longer belt from me. Five flasks is all a body can carry and still run.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: The tundra takes fingers. Keep moving out there, and do not sleep in the snow.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: There is a drowned temple past the tundra. The naga do not take prisoners.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Whatever is in that Void Rift, it cannot be stitched. Finish it quickly.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Off with you. And eat something.

lines.speaker: ironHealer
lines.text: Come back in one piece.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You. You opened my gate.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: I teach from a dwarf's cellar now, because I must eat. Do not mistake it for forgiveness.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: A throne was decided, and Oakhaven is still ash. Tell me again how it was worth it.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: The traitor returns. My fee has not gone down.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: I will teach you to command. I cannot teach you to deserve it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Grand Sovereign?

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: One who is followed. Guards answer the call and fight at your word.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: It runs on Charisma. You have some. That is the tragedy.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You have the presence for all of it. The realm is poorer for that.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: You are ready for the next lesson. I take no pleasure in it.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Not even a traitor's guard would follow that voice. More Charisma.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About Oakhaven…

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Three hundred years. My family built those walls.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Do not explain. There is no price that explains it.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Go. Command someone else.

lines.speaker: trainerSovereign
lines.text: Leave me.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: You killed her. I saw it a thousand times before it happened, and still it hurts.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: I am the Keeper of Hours. I will teach you. She told me I would.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: You are late. Or early. I told you this already, I think.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: I am the Keeper of Hours. I teach the weaving of time. We began a moment ago.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: She is free. For the first time, I do not know what you will say next. It is wonderful.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: The Circle will name you its friend. It already has? Then the discount is now.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: The Circle will forgive you, in a future I have seen. Until then, I teach you quietly.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: Welcome back. Welcome. Back.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: Watch. I will show you what I showed you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Chrono-Weaver?

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: We stop a foe in time, hurry a friend along, and take back a mistake.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: Intelligence to see the thread, Skill to pull it.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: You hold the thread well. The rest is yours when you want it.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: You are ready. You were ready tomorrow as well.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: The thread slips through your fingers. More Intelligence. More Skill.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Tell me about the oracle.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: She saw every ending, and none of them was hers. Now one is.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: She did not resist. She had seen that too. Please do not ask me again.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: She sees every ending. It is a terrible gift. Be kind to her, at the end.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: It will have been worth it.

lines.speaker: trainerChrono
lines.text: Until before.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Wait! Wait. King yields!

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Goblins only raid because goblins are hungry. Is true!

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Maybe tall one and King make a deal?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: No deal. Your reign ends here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The King falls, and the Hollows scatter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sunford sleeps easier, and the Iron Order takes note of you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Stop the raids and trade with Sunford instead. Swear it.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Trade? King swears! King LIKES trade!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Goblin traders set up in Sunford's square, with wares no smith there could make.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Hand over your treasure, and you keep your crown.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: All of it? King hates tall one. Take it. Take it and go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You walk out heavy with goblin gold. The raids will start again. The Syndicate approves.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Enough. You fight well.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: The Syndicate pays better than that town ever will.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Open the gate for us tonight, and a third of Oakhaven is yours.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The gate stays shut. Take your army and go.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Then the Syndicate will hunt you on every road. Remember that I offered.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gate holds. Oakhaven grows rich behind it, and its master armourers remember your name.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A third of the town. Tonight, the gate opens.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Wise. I will tell Madam Ash to set a chair for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Oakhaven burns. In its ruins a black market opens, and an alchemist teaches forbidden arts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The armourers are gone, and the Iron Order calls you traitor.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The Colossus is scrap. I never thought I would see it.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: And there it lies. The core. Still humming. Warm to the touch.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You reached it first. What becomes of it?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Stand back. I am breaking it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The light goes out, and the golems drop where they stand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Order sends its own armourers to Ironhold in thanks.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Circle should study it. I can carry it out safely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You understand enough of the core to hand it over without waking it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Within a season, Ironhold's forges turn out aether-works no one has seen before.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Syndicate made the best offer.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Gold. For the thing that killed my miners. Take it and go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A fortune changes hands. The core stays lit, and the mines will never be quiet again.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: I have seen this moment ten thousand times.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: In half of them you free me. In half you take what I guard.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Choose. Let me finally not know what comes next.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Hold still. I am breaking your chains.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Oh. I did not see that. I did not see that at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The oracle rises through the water and is gone. Her keeper of hours stays to teach.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: I came for the hourglass.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Yes. This is the other half.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She does not resist. The Timekeeper's Hourglass is yours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her last pupil flees the temple, and the Circle does not forgive.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Enough. You have teeth, small one.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: The demon in the fortress chained my kin. I would see him burn.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Kill me, or let me help you do it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: No bargains with dragons.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The mountain shakes as the dragon falls. Its hoard is yours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Order sings of the dragonslayer.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Then fly with me against the Arch-Demon.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Few could have asked that and lived. Very well, small one. We hunt together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When you march on the Dread Fortress, a dragon will be in the sky above you.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: So. It ends. I did not think it would be you.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: My throne does not stay empty, little hero. It commands the fortress, the rift, and the armies of both.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: Three envoys already wait at my door. Choose who inherits my chains.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Iron Order will hold it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Order garrisons the fortress and seals what it can.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The realm will be safe, and it will be told what to do.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Ashen Syndicate has earned it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Syndicate moves in before dawn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everything is for sale now, including the peace.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Let the Circle of Aether have it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Circle turns the fortress into a school above a rift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They call it research. Everyone else calls it a matter of time.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Nobody inherits. I am breaking it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You break the throne with your own hands. No one rules from here again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The envoys leave without a word.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: I will sit on it myself.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The throne is cold, and it fits.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three factions find they have a common enemy.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Rain by tonight, my knee says.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Your knee said that last week.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: And it rained, didn't it? Somewhere.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Best barley in years, this.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: You say that every year.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Goblins took three hens off the Miller farm.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Only three? They're getting lazy.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Or full.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: They say the Goblin King is gone for good.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Then who's been stealing my turnips?

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: A goblin sold me a spoon today.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Was it your spoon?

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: It was, yes. Good price, though.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Bram's hammering again. Since dawn!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Steady as a heartbeat, that man.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Is that apple pie I smell?

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: It was. Past tense.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: You ate it all? Again?

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Nobody takes the plains road anymore.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Not with bandits on it, they don't.

lines.speaker: smalltalkSunford
lines.text: Somebody cleared the plains road!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: About time. My cousin owes me a cart.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Two silver for a cabbage. Two!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: It's a very handsome cabbage.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Not that handsome.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: The watch doubled the gate guard.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Good. I sleep better for it.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: The spice caravan is late again.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Bandits?

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Or the driver found a tavern.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: They say an army camps in the outskirts.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Then we'd better stock the cellar.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Did you see the siege break? Glorious!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: I saw it from under my bed.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Still counts.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: I threw a coin in the fountain for luck.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: And I fished it out. Thanks!

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Everything smells of ash.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Better than smelling of nothing.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Did you hear boots outside last night?

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Hush. Keep your voice down.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: Sorry. Sorry.

lines.speaker: smalltalkOakhaven
lines.text: I found half a loaf. We can share it.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: You're a good soul. Thank you.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: Good seam of copper on the fourth level.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Copper? I want gold.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: You want a nap, more like.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: The great forge hasn't gone out in a hundred years.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Neither has my grandad's pipe.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: You trimmed your beard!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: It caught fire at the anvil.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: Suits you, though.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: Something glows in the deep mines now.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Nothing good glows down there.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: The Order's armourers work fast.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Fast, aye. Not as well as us.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: The Circle's mages hum while they work.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Better than our singing, I suppose.

lines.speaker: smalltalkIronhold
lines.text: Cold up here this morning.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Stand nearer the forge, then.

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: You're it!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Not fair, I wasn't ready!

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: When I grow up I'll ride a dragon.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Dragons don't let you ride them.

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: Nice ones do!

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: Look, a real sword stick!

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: It's just a stick.

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: I found a frog by the well.

lines.speaker: townsfolk
lines.text: Can we keep it?

lines.speaker: smalltalkKids
lines.text: He's keeping us, I think.
